zh: 週一三大指數同步收高：道瓊上漲 146.42 點（+0.28%）收 52,361.58，標普 500 上漲 0.70% 至 7,676.77，那斯達克上漲 0.82% 至 26,169.38，羅素 2000 上漲 0.38% 至 2,786.42。這是標普與那斯達克連兩週下跌之後的反彈，科技類股領漲，晶片股與 Anthropic 遞交上市申請是主要推手。恐慌指數 VIX 下降 5.45% 至 18.39。
en: All three major indexes closed higher Monday: the Dow rose 146.42 points (+0.28%) to 52,361.58, the S&P 500 gained 0.70% to 7,676.77, the Nasdaq added 0.82% to 26,169.38 and the Russell 2000 climbed 0.38% to 2,786.42. It was a bounce after two straight weekly losses for the S&P 500 and Nasdaq, led by tech, with chip stocks and Anthropic's IPO filing the main drivers. The VIX fell 5.45% to 18.39.

stocks.n: 標普 500 ETF，週一 +0.70%
那斯達克 100 ETF，週一那斯達克 +0.82%
道瓊 ETF，週一 +0.28%

zh: WTI 十二月合約收 101.25 美元（-0.50%），布蘭特從 112 美元附近回落到約 110 美元，起因是沙烏地國防部長訪問德黑蘭，緩和了前一週青年運動（Houthi）攻擊沙烏地造成的漲勢。十年期美債殖利率 4.986%，持平在 5% 之下；黃金下跌 0.18% 至約 4,031 美元；美國汽油均價每加侖 4.28 美元。油價回吐、殖利率不動，市場把注意力交給週三的聯準會。
en: WTI December crude settled at $101.25 (-0.50%) and Brent eased from near $112 to about $110 after Saudi Arabia's defense minister visited Tehran, cooling the rally that followed last week's Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia. The 10-year yield held at 4.986%, just under 5%, gold slipped 0.18% to about $4,031 and the US gasoline average was $4.28 a gallon. Oil gave back some gains and yields stood still, leaving the Fed on Wednesday as the focus.

stocks.n: 美國原油基金，WTI 小幅回吐
能源類股 ETF，油價回落後的觀察點
長天期美債 ETF，十年期殖利率 4.986%
黃金 ETF，週一 -0.18%

zh: Anthropic 週一公開遞交 S-1，代號將為 ANT。公開文件顯示，截至 6 月的上半年營收為 163 億美元，2025 全年只有 46 億美元；上半年 AI 基礎設施支出 90 億美元；約五分之一的營收來自兩家客戶；淨損 807 億美元，多數來自會計項目。它還與 SpaceX 簽下最高 1,205 億美元的算力協議，預計 12 月開始交付。市場把這份文件解讀為 AI 需求仍在，緩解了前幾週對 AI 支出的疑慮。
en: Anthropic publicly filed its S-1 on Monday and will trade as ANT. The filing shows $16.3 billion of revenue in the six months to June against $4.6 billion in all of 2025, $9 billion of AI infrastructure spending in the first half, about one-fifth of revenue from two customers and a net loss of $80.7 billion, mostly from accounting charges. It also commits up to $120.5 billion to SpaceX compute with delivery expected from December. Investors read it as proof AI demand is intact, easing recent worries about AI spending.

stocks.n: 輝達，AI 算力需求的代表，週一約 +2.4%
微軟，週三財報，AI 資本支出與雲端需求的對照

zh: Verizon 第三季後付費手機淨增 40.6 萬戶，是五年來最強的第三季，後付費帳戶淨增 13.7 萬，為十多年最佳。行動與寬頻服務營收 235 億美元，年增 2.9%；自由現金流 78 億美元，年增 12.1%；調整後 EBITDA 138 億美元，年增 8.0%，並連續第三季上調全年財測。上週五電信股因 SpaceX 傳聞重摔，這份成績單正好是對「競爭者進場」疑慮的第一個現實檢驗。
en: Verizon added 406,000 postpaid phone net subscribers in the third quarter, its best third quarter in five years, plus 137,000 postpaid net accounts, the best in over a decade. Mobility and broadband service revenue was $23.5 billion (+2.9%), free cash flow $7.8 billion (+12.1%) and adjusted EBITDA $13.8 billion (+8.0%), and it raised full-year guidance for a third straight quarter. After Friday's telecom sell-off on SpaceX reports, this is the first real-world test of the new-competitor worry.

stocks.n: Verizon，後付費手機淨增 40.6 萬、連三季上調財測
AT&T，上週五因 SpaceX 傳聞重摔近 8%
T-Mobile，上週五同樣重摔近 8%

zh: Meta 宣布計畫為 AI 基礎設施募集最高 950 億美元，第一筆先發行 350 億美元的股票。上週 Meta 剛把 2026 年資本支出上調到 1,350 億至 1,450 億美元，股價單日重挫約 7%，這次的重點變成「錢從哪裡來」。如果大型科技公司開始用發股與舉債來付 AI 帳單，就要同時檢視稀釋與利息成本，而十年期殖利率正貼近 5%。
en: Meta said it plans to raise up to $95 billion for AI infrastructure, starting with $35 billion of stock. Last week it lifted 2026 capital spending to $135 billion to $145 billion and the shares fell about 7% in a day, so the question is now where the money comes from. If big tech starts paying its AI bills with equity and debt, both dilution and interest cost matter, with the 10-year yield close to 5%.

stocks.n: Meta，募資最高 950 億美元、首批 350 億美元股票
微軟，週三財報，看資本支出與資金安排
亞馬遜，週四財報，同樣要交代資本支出

zh: 聯準會的兩天會議今天開始，週三下午 2 點公布利率決策，目標區間維持在 3.75% 至 4.00% 的機率約 90%。Yahoo 財經引述分析師說法，預期這會是一次「鷹派暫停」，主席是華許（Kevin Warsh），背景是通膨高於預期。先前 FinanceFeeds 的經濟學家調查顯示 100 位全部預期 12 月升息，所以重點在聲明與記者會有沒有為 12 月鋪路。
en: The Fed's two-day meeting begins today, with the decision due Wednesday at 2 p.m. and about a 90% chance of a hold at the 3.75% to 4.00% target range. Yahoo Finance cites analysts expecting a hawkish pause under Chairman Kevin Warsh after hotter-than-expected inflation. An earlier FinanceFeeds survey had all 100 economists expecting a December hike, so the focus is whether the statement and press conference pave the way.

stocks.n: 長天期美債 ETF，對利率路徑最敏感
短天期美債 ETF，反映政策利率預期
美元指數 ETF，鷹派訊號通常偏多美元

zh: 除了聯準會，歐洲央行、加拿大央行與日本央行本週也都有利率會議。主要央行同一週出手，意味著本週的匯率與殖利率反應不只來自華盛頓：任何一家的措辭偏鷹或偏鴿，都會經由匯市傳到美債。操作面要留意的是，同時有多個催化事件時，市場的單日波動往往比單一事件大。
en: Beyond the Fed, the European Central Bank, Bank of Canada and Bank of Japan all hold rate meetings this week. With several major central banks acting in the same week, currency and yield reactions will not come only from Washington, since a hawkish or dovish tone at any of them travels through FX to Treasuries. Single-day swings are often larger when several catalysts stack up.

stocks.n: 歐元 ETF，歐洲央行決策的直接對照
日圓 ETF，日本央行決策的直接對照
加幣 ETF，加拿大央行決策的直接對照

zh: 週一科技類股領漲，Lumentum（LITE）大漲約 10%，起因是 StoneX 以買進評等與 1,200 美元目標價開始涵蓋，Coherent 與 Applied Optoelectronics 跟著上漲。光通訊零組件是 AI 資料中心互連的受惠者，所以同一類股同步漲，比單一股票的消息更有訊號意義。不過目標價大幅高於現價時，通常也反映這類股的波動很大，追價前要看清楚。
en: Tech led on Monday, with Lumentum (LITE) up about 10% after StoneX initiated coverage with a Buy rating and a $1,200 price target, and Coherent and Applied Optoelectronics rose with it. Optical components benefit from AI data-center interconnect, so the group rising together carries more signal than a single-stock headline. A target far above the price also reflects how volatile this group is.

stocks.n: Lumentum，StoneX 買進評等、目標價 1,200 美元，約 +10%
Coherent，同類光通訊股同步上漲
Applied Optoelectronics，同類小型光通訊股同步上漲

zh: CoreWeave 在 AI 融資疑慮拖累數週之後週一轉為上漲。Yahoo 財經指出，八檔「新雲端」（neocloud）算力供應商組成的籃子，自 7 月下旬以來仍下跌超過 40%。這類公司的商業模式是用融資買晶片再出租算力，所以股價對資金成本與融資管道特別敏感；Meta 募資 950 億與 Anthropic 遞件，剛好是資金環境的兩個新資料點。
en: CoreWeave turned positive on Monday after weeks of AI-financing worries. Yahoo Finance noted a basket of eight neocloud compute providers is still down more than 40% since late July. These companies finance chips and rent out compute, so their shares are especially sensitive to funding costs and access, and Meta's $95 billion raise and Anthropic's filing are two new data points on that environment.

stocks.n: CoreWeave，新雲端代表，週一轉為上漲
Nebius，同屬新雲端算力供應商

zh: 巴西總統盧拉（Lula）出人意料地連任，擊敗弗拉維奧・波索納羅（Flávio Bolsonaro），先前的上漲預期反轉。Yahoo 財經的熱門榜顯示：XP 下跌約 48%、Banco Bradesco 約 -28%、Itaú 約 -20%、Nu Holdings 約 -17%、巴西國家石油（Petrobras）約 -14%；盤前 EWZ 曾跌約 26%。這些是盤中截圖數字，收盤可能不同，但訊號清楚：巴西金融與國營能源股被重新定價。
en: Brazilian President Lula won a surprise reelection over Flávio Bolsonaro, reversing an earlier rally. Yahoo Finance's most-active list showed XP down about 48%, Banco Bradesco about 28%, Itaú about 20%, Nu Holdings about 17% and Petrobras about 14%, and EWZ was down about 26% premarket. These are intraday snapshots and closes may differ, but the signal is clear: Brazilian financials and state-run energy are being repriced.

Nu Holdings，巴西數位銀行，約 -17%
Itaú Unibanco，巴西最大私人銀行，約 -20%
巴西國家石油，約 -14%

zh: 羅素 2000 週一收 2,786.42，上漲 0.38%，高於上週四的區間高點 2,784.03，終於結束連日窄幅整理。小型股沒有直接暴露在 AI 資本支出的疑慮裡，但同樣怕十年期殖利率貼近 5%，所以真正的突破要看週三聯準會之後能否站穩。短期只是跳出區間，還不能說趨勢改變。
en: The Russell 2000 closed Monday at 2,786.42, up 0.38%, above last Thursday's range high of 2,784.03 and ending several sessions of narrow consolidation. Small caps are not directly exposed to AI-capex worries but are just as sensitive to a 10-year yield near 5%, so a real breakout depends on holding after Wednesday's Fed. For now it is only a move out of a range, not a trend change.

stocks.n: 標普小型 600 ETF，品質較高的小型股對照

zh: Surgery Partners（SGRY）週一暴漲 47.62% 收 23.25 美元，起因是 Bon Secours 的關係企業 HealthSpan Partners 同意以每股 23.50 美元現金收購，相當於前一日收盤 15.75 美元的 49% 溢價，含負債交易價值約 57 億美元；持股約 39% 的 Bain Capital 仍會留任夥伴，預計 2027 年第一季完成。股價只低於收購價不到 1%，代表市場認為交易成功機率很高，後續上漲空間已很有限。
en: Surgery Partners (SGRY) jumped 47.62% to $23.25 on Monday after HealthSpan Partners, an affiliate of Bon Secours, agreed to buy it for $23.50 per share in cash, a 49% premium to the prior close of $15.75 and about $5.7 billion including debt. Bain Capital, which owns about 39%, stays on as a partner, and closing is expected in the first quarter of 2027. The shares trade less than 1% below the offer, so the market sees a high chance of completion and little upside left.

stocks.n: Surgery Partners，現金收購價 23.50 美元，收 23.25 美元

zh: Simply Wall St 10 月 13 日整理的「內部人買進的低估小型股」名單中，十家公司大半是區域銀行：Regional Management 本益比 6.6 倍、Financial Institutions 9.4 倍、Five Star Bancorp 14.6 倍、Shore Bancshares 11.3 倍。名單的「相對公允價值折價」是模型推算，不是分析師目標價。判讀小型銀行時，淨息差走勢與不良貸款比率比本益比更能說明趨勢，這也是本站雷達池常追的兩個數字。
en: A Simply Wall St list from October 13 of undervalued small caps with insider buying is mostly regional banks: Regional Management at 6.6 times earnings, Financial Institutions at 9.4, Five Star Bancorp at 14.6 and Shore Bancshares at 11.3. The discount to fair value is a model estimate, not an analyst target. For small banks, the net interest margin trend and non-performing loan ratio say more than the P/E, and those are the two numbers this feed's radar tracks most.

zh: Bank of Marin（BMRC）第三季淨息差從上一季的 3.38% 升到 3.48%（+10 個基點），淨利息收入 3,140 萬美元，比上一季增加約 62 萬，原因是新放款的收益率較高、存款利息支出下降。這家加州北灣的社區銀行是雷達池裡「淨息差能否回升」的驗證案例，這次財報算是通過第一個驗證點。風險：一季的回升還不是趨勢，信用成本與商用不動產曝險仍要追蹤。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: Bank of Marin Bancorp (BMRC) reported a third-quarter net interest margin of 3.48%, up 10 basis points from 3.38% the prior quarter, with net interest income of $31.4 million, about $619,000 higher, on higher yields on new loans and lower deposit costs. The North Bay community bank is the radar's test case for whether margins can recover, and this report passes the first checkpoint. Risk: one quarter is not a trend, and credit costs and commercial real estate exposure still need tracking. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

stocks.n: Bank of Marin，淨息差 3.38% → 3.48%

zh: MSG Sports 分拆案今天進入正式交易：MSG Rangers（MSGR）獨立掛牌，持有紐約遊騎兵（Rangers）、Hartford Wolf Pack 與 MSG 訓練中心；母公司改名 MSG Knickerbockers（代號 MSGK）。股東每持有兩股 MSG Sports 可獲得一股 MSGR，目標是免稅分配。分拆後的小公司常因被動賣壓與缺乏覆蓋而被忽視，所以首日到前幾週的成交最值得看。風險：Form 10 揭露的債務與獨立運營成本。這是研究線索，不是投資建議。
en: The MSG Sports separation reaches regular-way trading today: MSG Rangers (MSGR) lists on its own, holding the New York Rangers, Hartford Wolf Pack and MSG Training Center, while the parent is renamed MSG Knickerbockers (MSGK). Shareholders receive one MSGR share for every two MSG Sports shares, intended as a tax-free distribution. Spin-offs are often neglected because of forced selling and thin coverage, so the first days of trading are worth watching. Risks: the debt and standalone costs disclosed in the Form 10. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

stocks.n: MSG Rangers，今天起正式交易
MSG Sports，母公司（分拆後改名 MSGK）

en: Surgery Partners (SGRY), already in the radar pool, has reached the end of the neglect story: HealthSpan Partners agreed to pay $23.50 per share in cash and the stock rose 47.62% Monday. The pool's thesis was Bain Capital still holding about 39% after abandoning its own buyout last year and losses narrowing, and a new buyer has now completed a deal. What remains is a shareholder vote and regulatory approval, expected in the first quarter of 2027; upside is capped by the offer price and the main risk is the deal failing. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

en: Parke Bancorp (PKBK) is a New Jersey community bank with a market value of about $200 million and a P/E near 8.3. Low P/E, rising income and insider buying line up, but the article gives no purchase amounts or dates, so Form 4 filings need checking. Risks: past earnings declines, and commercial real estate concentration needs separate research. This is a research lead, not investment advice.

zh: 脊椎手術器材公司 Alphatec（ATEC）的 Keith Valentine 在 2026 年 1 月至 10 月間買進 13.5 萬股，約 99.6 萬美元。公司第二季淨損縮小到 2,578 萬美元（去年同期 4,114 萬美元），毛利率達 70.84%，市值約 12 億美元。內部人在虧損縮小的階段持續買進，比單筆買進更有參考價值，但本人持股比例與是否為公開市場買進，仍須看 Form 4 的交易代碼 P。
en: Keith Valentine bought 135,000 shares of spinal-surgery device maker Alphatec (ATEC), about $996,000, between January and October 2026. The company's second-quarter net loss narrowed to $25.78 million from $41.14 million a year earlier, gross margin reached 70.84% and market value is about $1.2 billion. Repeated insider buying while losses shrink is more informative than a single purchase, but the stake size and whether they were open-market buys (code P) should be confirmed on Form 4.

stocks.n: Alphatec，Valentine 買進 13.5 萬股約 99.6 萬美元，淨損縮小

zh: 看 Form 4 時先認交易代碼：只有代碼 P（公開市場買進）才是用自己的錢投票，獎勵股、行使選擇權與稅款代扣都不算。其次要看是否為預先設定的交易計畫（10b5-1），那類交易不代表當下的信心。群聚買進（三位以上獨立董事在 30 天內買進）比單人買進訊號強，但公司在壞消息後安排小額同步買進也不是沒有，所以金額相對於個人資產的比例才是關鍵。
en: On Form 4, first check the transaction code: only code P (open-market purchase) means spending one's own money, while grants, option exercises and tax withholding do not count. Next, check whether it falls under a pre-arranged 10b5-1 plan, which says little about current conviction. Cluster buying, with three or more independent directors in 30 days, is a stronger signal than a lone purchase, though small coordinated buys after bad news do happen, so the size relative to personal wealth is the key.

stocks.n: 標普小型 600 ETF，小型股內部人訊號的基準

zh: 政要的 PTR 申報金額只有寬區間，例如 1,001 到 15,000 美元、15,001 到 50,000 美元，沒有確切股數，所以無法精確算出部位大小。多數交易由配偶或信託帳戶執行，申報人不一定是下單的人。再加上法定可晚到 45 天才申報，我們看到的是 45 天前的價位。這個頻道只當成「有人用真錢押某個主題」的線索，不當買賣訊號。
en: Congressional PTR filings give only broad value ranges, such as $1,001 to $15,000 or $15,001 to $50,000, never exact share counts, so position size cannot be computed precisely. Many trades are made by spouses or trust accounts, so the filer is not always the person who placed the order. With a legal filing delay of up to 45 days, what we see reflects prices from weeks earlier. This channel is a clue about a theme someone backed with real money, not a trading signal.

zh: 週二（今天）：聯準會兩天會議開始。週三（10/28）：下午 2 點公布利率決策，同週歐洲央行、加拿大央行、日本央行也有會議。週四（10/29）：公布第三季 GDP 初值與 9 月 PCE，核心 PCE 預期年增 3.1%。聯準會決策日與兩家巨頭財報同一天，波動度可能集中在週三晚間到週四。各項日期請以官方公布為準。
en: Tuesday (today): the Fed's two-day meeting begins. Wednesday (Oct. 28): the rate decision is due at 2 p.m., and the ECB, Bank of Canada and Bank of Japan also meet this week. Thursday (Oct. 29): third-quarter GDP advance estimate and September PCE, with core PCE expected at 3.1% year on year. The Fed decision falls on the same day as two mega-cap earnings reports, so volatility may concentrate from Wednesday evening into Thursday. Confirm dates with official sources.

zh: 微軟與 Alphabet 週三（10/28）盤後公布財報，亞馬遜週四（10/29）公布；另有英特爾、Robinhood（HOOD）、禮來（LLY）、SanDisk 在本週名單上。市場焦點是雲端營收成長、資本支出與 AI 變現，Meta 剛宣布募資最高 950 億美元，也讓「資本支出怎麼付」成為這輪財報的新問題。財報日期以各公司公告為準。
en: Microsoft and Alphabet report after the close on Wednesday (Oct. 28) and Amazon on Thursday (Oct. 29), with Intel, Robinhood (HOOD), Eli Lilly (LLY) and SanDisk also on this week's list. The focus is cloud revenue growth, capital spending and AI monetization, and Meta's plan to raise up to $95 billion makes how to pay for capex a new question this round. Confirm dates with company announcements.

zh: 把今天放在一起：Anthropic 遞交 S-1 顯示上半年營收 163 億美元，卻同時虧損 807 億美元、承諾向 SpaceX 買最高 1,205 億美元算力；Meta 要募資最高 950 億美元；十年期殖利率 4.986%，聯準會很可能維持利率、並為 12 月升息鋪路。AI 需求看起來是真的，問題是資金成本。想想看：AI 這一輪的天花板，是需求，還是融資成本與股權稀釋的承受力？兩種答案會讓你去看不同的指標。
en: Put today together: Anthropic's S-1 shows $16.3 billion of first-half revenue alongside an $80.7 billion loss and up to $120.5 billion of compute commitments to SpaceX, Meta wants to raise up to $95 billion, the 10-year yield is 4.986% and the Fed will likely hold while paving the way for a December hike. AI demand looks real, and the question is the cost of capital. Is the ceiling on this AI cycle demand, or the market's capacity to absorb financing costs and dilution? The two answers point to different indicators.
